newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chelyabenergo '96 pretax profit up to 920 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Chelyabenergo '96 pretax profit up to 920 bln rbls.

text.p: Regional utility AO Chelyabenergo pre-tax profit rose to 920 billion roubles in 1996 from 490 billion roubles in 1995, according to preliminary data, a top company official said on Tuesday.
Nikolai Shchapin, deputy chief executive for economy, said final results for the year, calculated to Russian accounting standards, would be ready towards the end of January.
He said the company's power generation had risen 39.3 percent in 1996 over 1995's level.
He said 220 megawatts of total capacity had been added to three power stations and that a 100 megawatt turbine was being added to the Yuzhno-Uralskoi hydro-electric station.
He said the company's 1996 profit margin was 19.4 percent but did not give a 1995 comparison.
National power company RAO UES owns 59 percent of the shares of AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii Chelyabenergo and the Chelyabinsk region property fund owns a further 15.7 percent.
